description: disk-reclaim: at SessionStart, a one-line low-disk nudge (sub-second, global cooldown, snoozable) and a self-detaching (setsid), niced, read-only census that refreshes ~/.claude/disk-reclaim/last-census.json only when the ledger is over six hours old; the same census is registered at SessionEnd (which in headless sessions fires one to three minutes after the CLI returns) and the lock makes whichever runs second a no-op. Nothing on Stop. Every command exits 0 on every path.
